label: Trade War Room: the loaded-contract limit (max 5 per roster) is no longer silent when you're the one sending an offer. Building or reviewing an offer that would push your team (or a 3-way partner) over 5 loaded contracts now shows exactly who, the before/after count, and lets you pick which of your own loaded-contract players to drop before the offer can be sent -- on both mobile and desktop, for two-team and three-team trades alike. The picker shows the real players on your roster, never a guess. This is separate from the salary-cap acknowledgment and the structural-lineup check, which still work the same way they did.
